settings.headline: What happens after you eat matters.
settings.intro:
INCHY is whole-food nutrition organised around satiety — a non-pharmaceutical approach built from sacha inchi, a remarkable seed native to the Amazon rainforest.

Protein and fibre from the same seed, grown in Colombia by farmers we know by name.
settings.note: U.S. launch soon. The first run is small — the list gets it first.

settings.heading: FORM1 · The pouch
settings.copy: Unflavoured sacha inchi powder. Protein and fibre from the same seed, kept together in one whole-food preparation.

Sacha inchi has been eaten for thousands of years. But the organised supply chain we needed did not exist.

So we're helping build it: a growers association in northeast Colombia, seed bought direct from farmers we know by name, and shared standards for what good looks like.

settings.association_answer: Premium sacha inchi doesn't come from a spec sheet. It comes from the right altitude, the right soil and the right farmers. There was no organised market for this crop, so together with growers in northeast Colombia we helped establish an association to formalise it: direct purchasing, consistent quality, a reason to plant.
